# Results (generated by `npm run benchmark` on 2026-11-10)

150 ledgers × 18 weekly forecasts = 2700 forecasts per method.

## Overall (lower is better)

| Method | MAE (lei/week) | RMSE | sMAPE % | ms per forecast |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| NAIVE | 226.1 | 295.4 | 40.4 | 0.0001 |
| SMA | 174.0 | 224.4 | 32.1 | 0.0001 |
| SES | 178.8 | 232.1 | 33.1 | 0.0060 |
| HOLT | 216.6 | 278.0 | 40.1 | 0.0901 |
| DAMPED * | 195.6 | 251.2 | 36.0 | 0.5018 |

* exploratory method, added after the main experiment.

## MAE by spending profile (lei/week)

| Profile | NAIVE | SMA | SES | HOLT | DAMPED | Best |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| stable | 116.9 | 93.6 | 90.7 | 119.9 | 106.5 | SES |
| rising | 190.2 | 149.8 | 155.0 | 181.4 | 163.4 | SMA |
| falling | 93.3 | 78.0 | 80.6 | 90.7 | 82.2 | SMA |
| allowance | 329.2 | 217.8 | 249.4 | 296.6 | 264.4 | SMA |
| shocks | 401.0 | 330.8 | 318.4 | 394.4 | 361.8 | SES |

## Statistical tests (Wilcoxon signed-rank, paired by ledger)

| A vs B | Ledgers | MAE A | MAE B | A better by | A better on | z | p | effect r |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HOLT vs SMA (all) | 150 | 216.6 | 174.0 | -24.5 % | 13/150 | 10.21 | < 0.001 | 0.83 |
| HOLT vs SMA (rising+falling) | 60 | 136.1 | 113.9 | -19.5 % | 8/60 | 6.29 | < 0.001 | 0.81 |
| HOLT vs SES (all) | 150 | 216.6 | 178.8 | -21.1 % | 15/150 | 9.95 | < 0.001 | 0.81 |
| SES vs SMA (all) | 150 | 178.8 | 174.0 | -2.8 % | 60/150 | 2.82 | 0.005 | 0.23 |
| SMA vs NAIVE (all) | 150 | 174.0 | 226.1 | 23.0 % | 142/150 | -10.12 | < 0.001 | 0.83 |
| SES vs NAIVE (all) | 150 | 178.8 | 226.1 | 20.9 % | 144/150 | -10.29 | < 0.001 | 0.84 |
| HOLT vs NAIVE (all) | 150 | 216.6 | 226.1 | 4.2 % | 89/150 | -2.60 | 0.009 | 0.21 |

## Sensitivity: rising ledgers at different noise levels (MAE, lei/week)

| Daily noise σ | NAIVE | SMA | SES | HOLT | DAMPED | Best |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0.05 | 125.2 | 108.9 | 114.1 | 114.3 | 110.6 | SMA |
| 0.15 | 134.8 | 113.7 | 118.7 | 123.0 | 118.1 | SMA |
| 0.3 | 158.3 | 128.4 | 134.7 | 150.2 | 135.8 | SMA |
| 0.45 (main) | 190.2 | 149.8 | 155.0 | 181.4 | 163.4 | SMA |

## Hypotheses

- **H1** (HOLT beats SMA, p < 0.05, ≥ 10 % better on trend ledgers): **NOT SUPPORTED**
- **H2** (every smoothing method beats NAIVE, p < 0.05): **SUPPORTED**
- Lowest overall error: **SMA**
